title: The Lord, not Idols

questions.question: But now hear, O Jacob my servant, Israel whom I have what?
Fear not, O Jacob my servant, Jeshurun whom I have what?
For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:3 (ESV): "I will pour my Spirit upon your offspring,"

questions.question: Thus says the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts: "I am the first and I am the last; besides me there is no what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:6 (ESV): "besides me there is no god."

questions.question: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel, for you are my servant; I formed you; you are my servant; O Israel, you will not be what by me?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:21 (ESV): "O Israel, you will not be forgotten by me."

questions.question: This one will say, "I am the LORD's," another will call on the name of Jacob, and another will write on his hand, "The LORD's," and name himself by the name of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:5 (ESV): "and name himself by the name of Israel."

questions.question: Is there a God besides me? There is no Rock; I know what?
All who fashion idols are nothing, and the things they delight in do not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:9 (ESV): "and the things they delight in do not profit."

questions.question: He plants a cedar and the rain nourishes it. Then it becomes fuel for a man. He takes a part of it and warms himself; he kindles a fire and bakes bread. Also he makes a god and does what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:15 (ESV): "Also he makes a god and worships it;"

questions.question: He prays to it and says, "Deliver me, for you are my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:17 (ESV): "Deliver me, for you are my god!"

questions.question: He feeds on ashes; a deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, "Is there not a lie in my what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:20 (ESV): "Is there not a lie in my right hand?"

questions.question: I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud and your sins like what?
Sing, O heavens, for the LORD has done it; shout, O depths of the earth; break forth into singing, O mountains, O forest, and every what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:23 (ESV): "O forest, and every tree in it!"

questions.question: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, who formed you from the womb: "I am the LORD, who made who?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 44:24 (ESV): "I am the LORD, who made all things,"

questions.question: Who says of Cyrus, "He is my shepherd," and he shall fulfill all my purpose; saying of Jerusalem, "She shall be built," and of the temple, "Your foundation shall be what?"

key_verse_text: Thus says the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD of hosts: "I am the first and I am the last; besides me there is no god."
